readiness_rationale.DEEP_RESEARCH_PIPELINE: 3 real primary/academic/policy sources ingested end-to-end into claims+statistics+intelligence-object+report+vault, but only a fraction of the originally scoped acquisition queue (several named candidates remain ACCESS_BLOCKED or SEARCH_NOT_RUN).
readiness_rationale.PRIMARY_EVIDENCE: IEA + GridLab are real primary/policy-research sources with content actually read, not just leads; base IEA report page and Pew piece remain ACCESS_BLOCKED.
readiness_rationale.STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Upgraded from NOT_READY: 2 new IEA series admitted (observed 2024, forecast 2030/2035), correctly kept as separate series rather than merged; both are still INSUFFICIENT_SERIES (too few points for trend classification) and the World Bank per-capita series remains sector-undifferentiated, so CONDITIONALLY_READY not READY.
readiness_rationale.ACADEMIC_RESEARCH: 1 real arXiv paper (Jevons Paradox in Cloud Computing) ingested and claim-linked; it is general-cloud not AI-specific, and only 1 academic source total.
readiness_rationale.POLICY_RESEARCH: GridLab is policy-research-adjacent but narrow (one US regional grid-operator analysis); no broader cross-jurisdictional policy research (EU/China/Korea regulatory response, IEA's own policy recommendations beyond the exec summary) was pursued -- carried over NOT_READY from before this phase.
readiness_rationale.COUNTEREVIDENCE: Upgraded from NOT_READY: 5/10 directions now have real evidence (up from 0), 2 more partial, but 3 remain unsearched -- a genuine majority-covered but incomplete counterevidence base.
readiness_rationale.ALTERNATIVE_EXPLANATIONS: Upgraded from NOT_READY: 4/6 alternatives are now evidence-connected (2 at OBSERVED_EFFECT, 2 at POSSIBLE_IMPLICATION, one of those against itself); 2/6 remain general-knowledge-only.
readiness_rationale.LONGITUDINAL_EVIDENCE: No real BASELINE->TRANSITION->CURRENT chain exists; TRANSITION stage is not quantitatively isolated from any source acquired this phase.
readiness_rationale.GEOGRAPHIC_EVIDENCE: US/China/Europe split and a US-regional (PJM) finding exist, but no evidence for other major AI/data-center geographies (e.g. Korea, Southeast Asia, Middle East Gulf states) was acquired.
readiness_rationale.AI_ATTRIBUTION: Explicitly and consistently tagged PARTIAL/INDIRECT across every claim this phase touched, with the gap (no numeric AI-only split exists in any source) stated rather than papered over -- this discipline itself is why it is CONDITIONALLY_READY rather than NOT_READY, but it cannot be READY while no source gives a clean split.
readiness_rationale.FORECAST_OBSERVATION_SEPARATION: Enforced structurally: the 2024 observed and 2030/2035 forecast figures are two separate claims and two separate statistical series, never merged into one number or one trend computation.
readiness_rationale.EVIDENCE_INDEPENDENCE: 3 independent-origin sources (IEA policy research, arXiv academic, GridLab think-tank) plus 3 more for counterevidence (NVIDIA/trade press, IEA EV Outlook, EIA) -- real independence across source types, but still a small total source count for a topic this consequential.
readiness_rationale.UNCERTAINTY: Every new claim carries explicit AI_ATTRIBUTION and OBSERVED/FORECAST/ESTIMATED status; the intelligence object's uncertainties/known_gaps were updated rather than silently dropped.
readiness_rationale.PROVENANCE: Every claim/relation/series carries a real source_url; no fabricated or placeholder provenance was introduced.
readiness_rationale.PRIVATE_RESEARCH: No private-vault-eligible full-text sources were acquired or stored this phase; all ingested sources are openly accessible and only short excerpts/URLs are stored.
readiness_rationale.OBSIDIAN_ATOMIZATION: Upgraded from NOT_APPLICABLE: new claims/statistics atomized into vault_m6/ this phase, with the RESULT atom's stable ID/sources/relations preserved on update; CONDITIONALLY_READY rather than READY because the vault only covers this phase's items, not a full re-atomization pass across the whole AI_ENERGY_INFRA claim/evidence graph.
readiness_rationale.INTELLIGENCE_QUALITY: Claims/statistics/intelligence-object/report/vault are now mutually consistent and linked end-to-end for the 3 newly ingested sources; remaining gaps (policy research breadth, longitudinal chain, geographic breadth) keep it at CONDITIONALLY_READY.

central_honest_answer: Across the full O-0 phase (including this final pass): the AI_ENERGY_INFRA topic moved from a single undifferentiated World Bank statistic with zero connected counterevidence/alternative-explanations/report-currency, to 6 claims (4 newly grounded in 3 real, independently-read IEA/arXiv/GridLab sources with explicit OBSERVED/FORECAST and PARTIAL/INDIRECT AI-attribution tagging), 4 statistical series (2 new, forecast correctly kept separate from observation), 7 hypotheses with honestly mixed statuses, 5/10 counterevidence directions with real evidence (up from 0), 4/6 alternative explanations evidence-connected, an instrumented evidence-yield funnel with real per-stage counts, a regenerated v2 intelligence report reflecting real diffs, and atomized vault entries with preserved stable IDs. This is a genuine, verifiable improvement, not a completed deep-research pass: policy-research breadth, longitudinal evidence, broader geographic coverage, and 3 counterevidence directions remain real, disclosed gaps -- CONDITIONALLY_READY is the honest overall characterization, not READY.
